''R6'' - Numbee |rarity = {{Color|Common}} |looped = Yes |music = Yes |moveable = No |interactable = No |oldmusic = '''Version 1 Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Gang Dance Version 1|thumb|center|250px]] |newmusic = '''Version 2 Music''' [[File:Tower Defense Simulator OST - Gang Dance Version 2|thumb|center|250px]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|Epic joe reference|Store Description}} {{QuoteBox|Epic reference!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ == Description == '''Gang Dance'''is an [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought in the store for {{Coins|5,000}}. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/681405668/profile RostTyme]. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. You cannot move while performing this emote. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Animations}} GangDance.gif|First version (20 July 2019 – 29 October 2020) }} == Trivia == *This is currently the most expensive [[Emotes|emote]] that can be bought for coins. **During [[Hardcore Testing BETA]], [[Bloxy Cola]] was the most expensive emote before it was removed. *This emote was based on ''JoJo's Bizarre Adventure'' [https://youtu.be/AQx_KMoCgJU torture dance] from JJBA Golden Wind Episode 7. ==Update History== *'''20 July 2019''' - [[BETA v1.6|BETA v1.6.0d]] **'''Gang Dance''' added. *'''13 October 2019''' - [[Release v1.0|Release v1.0.0]] **New music added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Animation replaced. *'''22 March 2022''' - [[v1.1.0]]e **Music removed. *'''7 June 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]]c **Music re-added. {{EmoteNavBox}}
